diagnosis: The telehealth appointment details endpoint retrieves appointments by ID without checking if appointment.patientId matches the authenticated patient. An afterFind hook automatically fetches and attaches clinician personal clinical notes containing mental health assessments and sensitive diagnostic codes. Any patient can view private medical records and consultation notes of other patients.
